title: Routes file
description: A routes.yaml file: a list of gateway route entries.

route.title: Route entry
route.description: Maps an external path and method to a Kubernetes Service.

name.description: Unique route name (lowercase letters, digits, dashes).

path.description: External path, e.g. /orders. Must start with '/'. The same path may appear with different methods; each method + path pair must be unique (checked by validate_routes.py).

method.description: HTTP method. Together with path, forms the route key (e.g. 'GET /orders'), which must be unique.

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace of the backend Service.

auth.description: Auth mode. Known values: custom, none. The validator rejects 'none' on every route.
